name: AI
description: AI capability providers for kernel automation and suggestions.
author: Noah C. Omamalin

settings_fields.label: AI Provider
settings_fields.description: Which AI service to use: OpenAI (requires API key), Groq (OpenAI-compatible, requires API key), or Ollama (local server).

settings_fields.label: Model Tier
settings_fields.description: Quality tier: free tier (cost-optimized), paid tier (higher quality), or custom (specify which model).

settings_fields.label: OpenAI API Key
settings_fields.description: Your OpenAI API key (sk-...). Leave blank to keep existing.

settings_fields.label: OpenAI Free Model (preset)
settings_fields.description: Model used for free tier (e.g., gpt-4o-mini).

settings_fields.label: OpenAI Paid Model (preset)
settings_fields.description: Model used for paid tier (e.g., gpt-4o).

settings_fields.label: OpenAI Custom Model
settings_fields.description: Model used when tier is set to custom (e.g., gpt-4o-mini).

settings_fields.label: Groq API Key
settings_fields.description: Your Groq API key (gsk_...). Leave blank to keep existing.

settings_fields.label: Groq Free Model (preset)
settings_fields.description: Model used for free tier (e.g., llama-3.1-8b-instant).

settings_fields.label: Groq Paid Model (preset)
settings_fields.description: Model used for paid tier (e.g., llama-3.3-70b-versatile).

settings_fields.label: Groq Custom Model
settings_fields.description: Model used when tier is set to custom.

settings_fields.label: Gemini API Key
settings_fields.description: Your Google AI API key for Gemini. Get one at aistudio.google.com.

settings_fields.label: Gemini Free Model (preset)
settings_fields.description: Model used for free tier (default: gemini-2.5-flash).

settings_fields.label: Gemini Paid Model (preset)
settings_fields.description: Model used for paid tier (default: gemini-2.5-pro).

settings_fields.label: Gemini Custom Model
settings_fields.description: Model used when tier is set to custom.

settings_fields.label: Cerebras API Key
settings_fields.description: Your Cerebras API key. Get one at cloud.cerebras.ai. Extremely fast inference.

settings_fields.label: Cerebras Free Model (preset)
settings_fields.description: Model used for free tier (default: llama-4-scout-17b-16e-instruct). 30 RPM free.

settings_fields.label: Cerebras Paid Model (preset)
settings_fields.description: Model used for paid tier (default: llama3.1-70b).

settings_fields.label: Cerebras Custom Model
settings_fields.description: Model used when tier is set to custom.

settings_fields.label: OpenRouter API Key
settings_fields.description: Your OpenRouter API key. A single key gives access to many models (free and paid).

settings_fields.label: OpenRouter Free Model (preset)
settings_fields.description: Model used for free tier (default: meta-llama/llama-4-scout:free). Many free models available.

settings_fields.label: OpenRouter Paid Model (preset)
settings_fields.description: Model used for paid tier (default: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4).

settings_fields.label: OpenRouter Custom Model
settings_fields.description: Model slug when tier is set to custom (e.g., google/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:free).

settings_fields.label: Mistral API Key
settings_fields.description: Your Mistral AI API key. Get one at console.mistral.ai.

settings_fields.label: Mistral Free Model (preset)
settings_fields.description: Model used for free tier (default: mistral-small-latest).

settings_fields.label: Mistral Paid Model (preset)
settings_fields.description: Model used for paid tier (default: mistral-large-latest).

settings_fields.label: Mistral Custom Model
settings_fields.description: Model used when tier is set to custom.

settings_fields.label: Ollama Base URL
settings_fields.description: URL to your local Ollama server (e.g., http://localhost:11434).

settings_fields.label: Ollama Free Model (preset)
settings_fields.description: Model used for free tier (e.g., llama3.2:3b).

settings_fields.label: Ollama Paid Model (preset)
settings_fields.description: Model used for paid tier (e.g., llama3.1:8b).

settings_fields.label: Ollama Custom Model
settings_fields.description: Model used when tier is set to custom.
